Callout.Name: Argument at Visits
Callout.Message: Argument in the visits hall, staff asking for support.
Callout.Advisory: Two visitors, no violence, staff holding them apart.

Script.Line: It is two families in the visitors hall and it is getting loud.
Nobody has thrown anything yet. That is the bit I would watch.
We are pulling the visit now, before it gets any worse.

Lines.Approach: Two of them over a table and the staff have them apart. It is loud, not violent.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
